import types
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=False,
    APPEND_SLASH=True,
    ALLOWED_HOSTS=["*"],
    SECRET_KEY="x",
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=[
        "django.contrib.admin",
        "django.contrib.auth",
        "django.contrib.contenttypes",
        "django.contrib.sessions",
        "django.contrib.messages",
        "django.contrib.staticfiles",
    ],
    MIDDLEWARE=[
        "django.contrib.sessions.middleware.SessionMiddleware",
        "django.contrib.auth.middleware.AuthenticationMiddleware",
        "django.contrib.messages.middleware.MessageMiddleware",
    ],
    TEMPLATES=[{
        "BACKEND": "django.template.backends.django.DjangoTemplates",
        "APP_DIRS": True,
        "OPTIONS": {"context_processors": [
            "django.contrib.auth.context_processors.auth",
            "django.contrib.messages.context_processors.messages",
        ]},
    }],
    ROOT_URLCONF="check_urls",
    STATIC_URL="/static/",
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)

mod = types.ModuleType("check_urls")
from django.contrib import admin
from django.urls import path
urlpatterns = [path("admin/", admin.site.urls)]
mod.urlpatterns = urlpatterns
import sys
sys.modules["check_urls"] = mod

django.setup()

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.test import Client

User.objects.create_superuser("admin", "a@a.com", "pw")
c = Client()
c.force_login(User.objects.get(username="admin"))

r = c.get("/admin/auth/foo?id=123")
print("status:", r.status_code)
print("location:", r["Location"])
assert r.status_code == 301
assert r["Location"] == "/admin/auth/foo/?id=123", r["Location"]
print("OK: query string preserved in redirect")
